intro: Brunei is made of two separate parts on the north coast of Borneo, surrounded by Malaysia's Sarawak state.

chapters.title: Rainforest and coast
text: Over 70% of the land is rainforest, much of it protected, such as Ulu Temburong National Park. The coast has mangroves and beaches.

chapters.title: Climate
text: Brunei is hot and wet all year, on the edge of the equator.

keyTerms.meaning: Part of a country separated from the rest.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Brunei's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.

items.name: Ulu Temburong
items.text: A canopy walkway above the jungle.
